method: COLD then WARM IDENTICAL prompt (~3800 tok). latent_capture gives per-LOGICAL-position fp8-latent SHA; selection_capture gives per-layer SELECTED logical positions at first decode step. Correlate: for each flipped logical position (cold-top-k XOR warm-top-k), compare cold vs warm latent SHA at that position. bytes differ -> cause (a); bytes identical -> cause (b).
raw_pt_dumps: DELETED after computing the comparison (kept only summary.json + flip_position_table.jsonl.gz)
